comments:
I've sent a fix to review. Would you be able to confirm it works? 

Sorry for the bug.
@Desvauxm-st sorry for a late question. Are the results of your test runs available somewhere or it is an internal thing?
Thanks for the info. I don't need archive of this test, just asking about access to test results :).
One more question, is there any easy way to read the result? E.g. If I would like to get 5 last results of a specific test for a specific board. Or I just need to grep commits.
TBH, I don't know. @hakehuang might be able to answer as Testing group chairman

review_comments:
What about ?
Moving entropy_stm32_resume in acquire_rng
Moving entropy_stm32_suspend in release_rng

This might require some investigation, but would result in more consistent code.
It should work. Looks cleaner now :-)
Looks it solves the on going issues and hence a welcome addition, but is there a proper explanation ?

I did some testing and it looks like the IE bit in CR register is sometimes cleared when the device clock is disabled. It looks like it happens only on H7 chip. Unfortunately, I haven't fine any confirmation of such behavior in RM.
